name: supernormal
description: Your Supernormal Rooms in your AI agent: wiki, documents, databases, chat, tasks and connected apps.

interface.longDescription:
Supernormal Rooms are shared workspaces for a team: conversation, files, a wiki, databases such as issue trackers, and each member's own notes, meetings and task board. This plugin lets you work in your Rooms from chat.

What you can do:
- Catch up on a Room: recent chat, documents, meeting notes, goals and what changed.
- Find what was decided or said about something, across every Room you can see.
- Draft, edit, rename and move documents and wiki pages in a Room.
- Read and update a Room's issue trackers and boards: file, triage and summarize issues.
- Work through tasks on your task board, report back on them and create new ones.

Who it's for: teams that use Supernormal for meetings and shared work. You need a Supernormal account; you sign in once, and the plugin acts as you and sees only the Rooms you can see.

Limits: it reads Room chat, comment threads and goals but never posts, replies, reacts or changes a goal. It changes documents, databases and tasks only when you ask.
defaultPrompt: Catch me up on what happened in my Supernormal Rooms this week
What did we decide in my most recent meetings?
Draft a project plan in our team Room from today's discussion
